acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the .nit/skills/ directory, When listing skill directories, Then e2e-orchestration, init, and status skill directories exist with SKILL.md files.
Given the nit:orchestrate skill, When reading its workflow steps, Then all pipeline steps are wired: clarify → phases → tasks → design → implement → review → phase-summary.
Given the nit:init skill, When invoked in a git repository, Then it creates .nit/ directory structure with config/nit.yaml containing the selected mode.

Given the nit:status skill, When invoked on an initialized workspace, Then it displays phase/task tree with statuses, suggests the next step, and lists all available /nit:* commands including init, phase-summary, and brownfield-orchestrate.
